notes.title: T-Hunt Mode Out Now
notes.content:
[p]Attention, squadmates!

HQ here with the latest intel. Enemies have infiltrated and we need you and your squad to take them out via...

[b]T-HUNT! Our brand new game mode designed for ALL skill levels.[/b] 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/4879adac4f253d389c31e35f5de4675bb56ed2b0.gif"][/img]

T-Hunt is all about randomised enemy spawns and patrol movements. Implemented on maps you already know and love no run is ever the same. It's a test of your adaptability and tactics. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/26a937dbac734e7e32e0d9ff756cde3b64f3156d.gif"][/img]


[b]Not only that, but Phantom Squad is also 20% off for a limited time![/b] Grab this discount before it's taken out...

Looking to squad up? [url="https://discord.gg/zQU5w8Fuq8"]Then find yours in Discord[/url] and hop in. [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2841770/discussions/0/601910394159677025/"]Read our full changes that accompany T-Hunt here.[/url]

Are you ready to take on the hunt? T-Hunt starts NOW! 

- The Phantom Squad team.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.1.1
notes.content:
[p]What, our 2025 roadmap not enough for ya?
Then gear up AND squad up as we drop our 1.1.1 patch! [/p][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/db13e5872e5256d6f185faf000481d2d2dc4c30e.png"][/img]

[u][b]General fixes/QOL[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Made NVG less bright/white.[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo case now refills knives, grenades and claymores as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed door wedge can make double doors non-interactable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Flashing shield; can flash teammates behind or on the sides.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed throwing knives that were floating in the air and couldn't be picked up.[/p][/*][*][p]Added texts and icons to invite people to Discord to find a squad.[/p][/*][*][p]Remembered zoom level in ACE.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters in French localisation.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected claymore orientation and fixed player claymore (expanded trigger zone, civilians don’t trigger them anymore).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ESC menu then "mission failed popup" two menus.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][u][b]Mission specific fixes - watch out for spoilers[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]M2 Power Down:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Disabling metal detectors when generator is shutdown.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]M4 Deadwire:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made exfil zone bigger.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]M6 Chainbreaker:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Balancing tweaks: Removed some cameras and one door, electrocution is more permissive when more players are connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clients are spawned at last checkpoint when host restarts level from the beginning.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]M7 Party Hard:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Set proper hostage count to 10.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]M10 Ghost Walker:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed enemy can’t trigger alarm when handcuffed & other various issues with enemy behavior near alarms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed alarm position information in ACE.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]M11 Terminal:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed enemies guarding VIP can detonate or shoot even when handcuffed.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved some props around in M11 to avoid getting stuck on them.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We also want to thank the 200+ squadmates who have left us a review so far! Because of you, we've welcomed many more squadmates into the game. Haven't left a review yet? You can do so via the link below. You can also find squadmates on Discord! [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FzQU5w8Fuq8"]Join our server here, choose your loadout and squad UP.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the field,[/p][p]The Phantom Squad Team.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841770/Phantom_Squad/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

tags.balance_change: Balancing tweaks: Removed some cameras and one door, electrocution is more permissive when more players are connected.

tags.bug: Made NVG less bright/white.
Ammo case now refills knives, grenades and claymores as well.
Fixed door wedge can make double doors non-interactable.
Fixed Flashing shield; can flash teammates behind or on the sides.
Fixed throwing knives that were floating in the air and couldn't be picked up.

tags.bug: Remembered zoom level in ACE.
Fixed characters in French localisation.
Corrected claymore orientation and fixed player claymore (expanded trigger zone, civilians don’t trigger them anymore).
Fixed ESC menu then "mission failed popup" two menus.
Disabling metal detectors when generator is shutdown.
Made exfil zone bigger.
Fixed clients are spawned at last checkpoint when host restarts level from the beginning.
Set proper hostage count to 10.
Fixed enemy can’t trigger alarm when handcuffed & other various issues with enemy behavior near alarms.
Fixed alarm position information in ACE.
Fixed enemies guarding VIP can detonate or shoot even when handcuffed.
Moved some props around in M11 to avoid getting stuck on them.

tags.feature: Added quickping to be used without toggling ACE (middle mouse button by default).

tags.bug: Melee attacks don’t hit sometimes.
Made tutorial instructions legible on Steam Deck.
Russian keyboard displays wrong input prompts.
Hostages don’t follow players between floors.
Changing healing target mid-healing now cancels the healing instead of healing new target. Avoids healing the wrong target mistakenly.
Player bullets can go through enemy if really close up.
Player stuck in handcuff anim if another player finishes handcuffing an enemy before them.
Hostage stuck in stun animation, if stun then quickly ordered to follow a player.
Stun stacking (ex: fixed tazer then bullet doesn’t cancel tazer stun now).
Hide equipment wheel on dying, game over, ACE toggle.
Initial mission objective sometimes not displaying.
Flashing shield flashing a bit too much on the sides (can blind players that feel they shouldn’t).
Lobby: added colliders to avoid being stuck in the environment.
Do not auto complete mission after all terrorists are dead so players can still defuse the traps or exfiltrate if they don't want to.
Moved a landmine that was posing issues with a door.
Tweaked a few objects that were too high for the line of fire.
Changed doors: no peephole interaction, peephole always open and centered.
Moved some geometry around to improve visibility of camera cones or navigation.
Doors can be closed from further away to avoid players being dragged by the closing door.
Tweaked dog room at the beginning to avoid dog going through wall.
Security doors show radio message on server and not interacting client.
Sometimes enemies are disabled on client-side.
Removed a camera that was stuck inside a wall.
Tweaked the dog intro.
Tweaked the room before garden (made easier).

tags.balance_change: Tweaked computers to hack 2 and 3 so they are slightly more challenging.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0.1
notes.content: [p]Gather round, squadmates![/p][p][/p][p] We're here to give an update on [b][i]Patch 1.0.1[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Mission Brief is as follows:[/b][/p][p]- We've added [b]checkpoints[/b] [b]to Mission 6 ([i]Chainbreaker[/i]).[/b][/p][p]- We've added a “reload from last checkpoint” button in the game over screen[/p][p]- We've made it so players can replay missions they have finished with friends, even if they haven’t finished the missions leading up to it.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll be continuing to patch and test parts of the game as the launch period continues, so be sure to jump into Discord to share your feedback and suggestions![/p][p][/p][p]See you on the field,[/p][p]The Phantom Squad Team[/p]

tags.feature: - We've added a “reload from last checkpoint” button in the game over screen
- We've made it so players can replay missions they have finished with friends, even if they haven’t finished the missions leading up to it.
